explanations.authorised-1110112: Wheatstone bridge is correct. A Wheatstone bridge is a null method that can measure resistance accurately, especially for small values. A Wheatstone bridge is especially sensitive to small resistance differences because the balance condition compares the unknown resistance with known resistance ratios, allowing a small change to be detected accurately.
explanations.authorised-1110114: 13.3cm is correct. Apparent depth = real depth / n. So real depth = apparent depth × n = 10 × 1.33 = 13.3 cm. For an object viewed through a plane surface, real depth = refractive index × apparent depth. The apparent depth is smaller because light bends toward the normal when it enters the less optically dense medium.
explanations.authorised-1110116: M L T⁻² is correct. Tension is a force, and the dimension of force is mass × acceleration = M L T⁻². Tension is a force, so it has the dimensions of force: MLT⁻². The deciding feature here is the measurements and units relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110117: 100Pa is correct. Pressure = Force/Area = 5000 / (10×5) = 5000/50 = 100 Pa. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110118: waves that reflect off a boundary and interfere with themselves is correct. Standing waves are formed by the superposition of two identical waves traveling in opposite directions, typically from reflection. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110119: Unchanged is correct. Speed of sound in air depends on temperature, not pressure (at constant temperature, pressure changes do not affect speed as density ratio is constant). The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110120: Semi-conductor is correct. Photovoltaic cells use semiconductor materials (like silicon) to convert light energy into electrical energy via the photoelectric effect. The deciding feature here is the introductory electronics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110122: 8.3 x 10⁻¹¹ F is correct. C = ε₀A/d, A = πr² = 3.142×(0.06)² = 0.01131 m², d=0.0012m. C = 8.85e-12 × 0.01131 / 0.0012 ≈ 8.3e-11 F. The deciding feature here is the electrostatics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110123: 2666.7JKg⁻¹K⁻¹ is correct. Q = mcΔT ⇒ c = Q/(mΔT) = 1000 / (0.025×15) = 1000 / 0.375 = 2666.7 J/kg·K. Use Q = mcΔT because the iron changes temperature without a phase change. The temperature change is the difference between the initial and final temperatures.
explanations.authorised-1110124: 240m is correct. Distance = speed × time = 60 m/s × 4 s = 240 m. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110125: Resistance thermometer is correct. Resistance thermometers have very high sensitivity and respond quickly to temperature changes due to the rapid change in electrical resistance. The deciding feature here is the quantity of heat relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110130: Diverging lens of focal length 95cm is correct. Short-sightedness (myopia) is corrected with a diverging (concave) lens that has a focal length equal to the far point distance. The deciding feature here is the optical instruments relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110131: 50.40Kwh is correct. Energy = Power × time = 150 W × 336 h = 50400 Wh = 50.40 kWh. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110132: Soft iron is correct. Soft iron has high permeability and is used for magnetic shielding because it provides a low-reluctance path for magnetic flux. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110133: Electrophorus is correct. An electrophorus is a device for generating static electricity, not for detecting radiation. The deciding feature here is the modern physics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110134: Ammonium chloride is correct. The wet Leclanche cell uses ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) solution as the electrolyte. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110135: Induced emf is correct. The voltage generated by changing magnetic flux is called induced electromotive force (emf). The deciding feature here is the electromagnetic induction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110136: Ampere is correct. Ampere is one of the seven base SI units (for electric current). Joule, Volt, and Ohm are derived units. The deciding feature here is the measurements and units relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110137: a wavelength is correct. The distance between two successive troughs (or crests) is one full wavelength. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110138: Red is correct. Red light has the lowest frequency (and longest wavelength) in the visible spectrum. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110139: 110 is correct. Number of images per object = (360/θ) - 1 = (360/30) - 1 = 11. With 10 objects, total = 10×11 = 110. The deciding feature here is the reflection relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110140: decrease in the overall capacitance of the capacitors is correct. In series, the equivalent capacitance is less than each individual, so energy stored (½CV²) is reduced for the same voltage. The deciding feature here is the electrostatics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110142: Ciliary muscle is correct. The ciliary muscles change the shape of the lens to adjust its focal length, a process called accommodation. Lens questions are governed by the lens formula 1/f = 1/u + 1/v together with the magnification relationship when image size is involved.
explanations.authorised-1110143: The sun, moon, and earth comes in straight line is correct. An annular solar eclipse occurs when the moon is too far from Earth to completely cover the sun, leaving a ring of sunlight visible. The deciding feature here is the modern physics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110144: 416.67N is correct. Weight on moon = (1/6) × weight on earth = (1/6) × 2500 = 416.67 N. The deciding feature here is the gravitational field relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110145: Reduce the friction of fluid is correct. Streamlined shapes reduce fluid friction (drag), allowing smoother motion through air or water. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110147: 40.0N is correct. Gravitational force is proportional to product of masses. If both masses double, product increases by 4, so force becomes 10×4=40N. The deciding feature here is the gravitational field relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110148: 0.5Hz is correct. Frequency f = 1/(2π) √(g/L). L=1.2m. f = 1/(2*22/7) * √(10/1.2) = 7/44 * 2.887 = 0.159*2.887 ≈ 0.459 Hz ≈ 0.5 Hz. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110149: E = E₁ + E₂ + E₃ is correct. Cells in series add their emfs: E_total = E₁ + E₂ + E₃. (Assuming they are connected in series aiding). The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110150: medium of propagation is correct. Water waves are mechanical and require a medium; light waves are electromagnetic and can travel through vacuum. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1110151: heating a magnetic bar red hot and allowed to cool e-w direction is correct. Heating a magnet above its Curie temperature and cooling in an east-west orientation (or without a magnetic field) demagnetizes it. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140001: it has high resistance is correct. Voltmeters have high resistance to avoid diverting current. The deciding feature here is the measurements and units relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140002: Kinetic energy of molecules is correct. Temperature is proportional to average kinetic energy of molecules. The deciding feature here is the temperature and measurement relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140003: Parallel to the direction of wave travel is correct. Sound is a longitudinal wave; particles vibrate parallel to wave propagation. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140004: 10 D is correct. P = 1/f (in meters) = 1/0.1 = 10 D. Lens questions are governed by the lens formula 1/f = 1/u + 1/v together with the magnification relationship when image size is involved. The deciding feature here is the optical instruments relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140005: Current is correct. Electric current is the rate of flow of charge (I = Q/t). The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140006: 6.63×10⁻³⁵ m is correct. λ = h/mv = 6.63e-34 / (1×10) = 6.63e-35 m. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140007: Watt is correct. Power is measured in watts (W). The deciding feature here is the measurements and units relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140008: Both net force and net torque are zero is correct. For equilibrium, both resultant force and resultant torque must be zero. The deciding feature here is the equilibrium of forces relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140009: Declination is correct. Magnetic declination is the angle between true north and magnetic north. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140010: 6.67 Ω is correct. 1/R = 1/10 + 1/20 = 3/20 → R = 20/3 ≈ 6.67 Ω. In parallel, each branch has the same potential difference and the total conductance is the sum of the branch conductances. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140011: 1.5 is correct. n = c/v = 3e8 / 2e8 = 1.5. The deciding feature here is the refraction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140012: 4 m/s² is correct. W = mg → g = W/m = 20/5 = 4 m/s². The deciding feature here is the gravitational field relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140013: 50 Hz is correct. f = 1/T = 1/0.02 = 50 Hz. The wave relationship v = fλ links speed, frequency and wavelength; use the quantities actually supplied by the question. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140014: 48 V is correct. Vs = Vp × Ns/Np = 240 × 100/500 = 48 V. The deciding feature here is the electromagnetic induction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140015: Latent heat of vaporization is correct. Latent heat of vaporization is for liquid→gas at boiling point. The deciding feature here is the quantity of heat relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140016: It converges light rays is correct. Convex lenses converge parallel rays to a focal point. The deciding feature here is the optical instruments relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140017: Volt is correct. Voltage is measured in volts (V). The deciding feature here is the electrostatics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140018: 64 N is correct. F = mv²/r = 2×16/0.5 = 64 N. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140019: Dispersion is correct. Dispersion splits white light into its constituent colours. The deciding feature here is the dispersion and colours relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140020: Diffraction is correct. Diffraction is the bending of waves around obstacles or through openings. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140021: (i), (ii) and (iv) only is correct. Photocells use semiconductors, not gas conduction; identification of gases, lighting, and CRO use gas discharge. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140022: T₁ = 2760 N, T₂ = 3502 N is correct. Using equilibrium equations: vertical components balance weight, horizontal components balance each other. The deciding feature here is the equilibrium of forces relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140023: 391 m is correct. Range R = u²sin2θ/g = 75²×sin44°/10 = 5625×0.695/10 ≈ 391 m. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140024: 80 is correct. At 40°C, SVP of water ≈ 48.5 mmHg. RH = (38.8/48.5)×100 ≈ 80%. The deciding feature here is the gas laws relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140025: 422.7 is correct. P = P₀ + ρgh = 101300 + 1000×9.8×32.8 = 101300 + 321440 = 422740 Pa ≈ 422.7 kPa. The deciding feature here is the pressure relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140026: 20.0V is correct. I = E/(R+r) = 24/(5+1) = 4 A; V = IR = 4×5 = 20 V. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140027: 0.05775 day⁻¹ is correct. λ = ln2/T½ = 0.693/12 = 0.05775 day⁻¹. The deciding feature here is the modern physics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140028: is equal to the number of free electrons is correct. In intrinsic semiconductors, the number of free electrons equals the number of holes. The deciding feature here is the introductory electronics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140029: A - unstable, B - neutral, C - stable is correct. Stable: returns to position; unstable: moves away; neutral: remains in new position. The deciding feature here is the equilibrium of forces relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140030: (ii), (iii) and (iv) only is correct. Rainbow involves dispersion, total internal reflection, and refraction. Total internal reflection requires light to travel from an optically denser medium to a less dense medium and the incidence angle to exceed the critical angle. The deciding feature here is the dispersion and colours relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140031: 2.5kw is correct. P = kAΔT/d = 0.6071×620×(25-15)/1.5 = 0.6071×620×10/1.5 = 3764/1.5 ≈ 2509 W ≈ 2.5 kW. The deciding feature here is the heat transfer relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140032: Nuclear fusion is correct. Stars produce energy through nuclear fusion (hydrogen to helium). The deciding feature here is the modern physics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140033: 7.5×10⁴ J is correct. Work = ΔKE = ½m(v²-u²) = 0.5×1200×(225-100) = 600×125 = 75,000 J = 7.5×10⁴ J. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140034: 2.4×10¹⁰ (Nm⁻²) is correct. Stress = F/A = 15/(π×(0.0002)²) = 15/(1.256e-7) ≈ 1.19e8 Pa. Strain = 0.005. E = stress/strain ≈ 2.4e10 Pa. Young's modulus is stress/strain, so both the force per unit area and extension per original length must be found before taking their ratio.
explanations.authorised-1140035: 379 is correct. ω = 2π×120/60 = 4π rad/s; T = mω²r = 2×(4π)²×1.2 = 2×16π²×1.2 ≈ 379 N. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140037: 5.82 cm is correct. Using Boyle's law: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂. P₁ = 12+10.34=22.34m of water; P₂=10.34m. V∝r³ → r₂ = r₁×(P₁/P₂)^(1/3) = 4.5×(22.34/10.34)^(1/3) = 4.5×1.293 ≈ 5.82 cm. The deciding feature here is the gas laws relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140038: 42.5nC is correct. C = ε₀A/d = 8.85e-12×0.8/0.02 = 3.54e-10 F. Q = CV = 3.54e-10×120 = 4.248e-8 C = 42.5 nC. The deciding feature here is the capacitors relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140039: 7940 J is correct. Heat = m[c_ice×10 + L + c_water×10] = 0.02[2100×10 + 334000 + 4200×10] = 0.02[21000+334000+42000] = 0.02×397000 = 7940 J. Specific heat capacity relates heat transferred to mass and temperature change through Q = mcΔT. The deciding feature here is the quantity of heat relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140040: 5.09×10¹⁴ Hz is correct. Frequency remains constant: f = c/λ = 3e8 / (589e-9) = 5.09×10¹⁴ Hz. The wave relationship v = fλ links speed, frequency and wavelength; use the quantities actually supplied by the question. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140042: 5 is correct. Wave number k = 2π/λ. λ = v/f = 20/16 = 1.25 m. k = 2π/1.25 ≈ 5.0 m⁻¹. The wave relationship v = fλ links speed, frequency and wavelength; use the quantities actually supplied by the question. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140043: 60 kg·m/s is correct. p = mv = 10×6 = 60 kg·m/s. Momentum is p = mv, and in an isolated system total momentum is conserved during a collision or interaction. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140044: 2.26×10⁸ m/s is correct. v = c/n = 3e8 / 1.33 ≈ 2.26e8 m/s. The deciding feature here is the refraction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140045: 48 V is correct. Vs = Vp × Ns/Np = 240 × 200/1000 = 48 V. The deciding feature here is the electromagnetic induction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140046: Critical angle is correct. The critical angle is the angle of incidence that produces a 90° angle of refraction. The deciding feature here is the reflection relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140047: 400 J is correct. KE = PE at top = mgh = 2×10×20 = 400 J. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140048: Work is correct. Work = Force × distance in direction of force. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140049: 10 V is correct. I = E/(R+r) = 12/(5+1) = 2 A; V = IR = 2×5 = 10 V. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140050: Real, inverted, and same size is correct. At the centre of curvature, image is real, inverted, and same size. The deciding feature here is the reflection relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140051: Increases is correct. Speed of sound increases in water; frequency remains constant, so wavelength increases. The deciding feature here is the characteristics of sound relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140052: 18 J is correct. KE = ½mv² = 0.5×4×9 = 18 J. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140053: Farad is correct. Capacitance is measured in farads (F). The deciding feature here is the capacitors relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140054: 35.3° is correct. sin r = sin i / n = sin60/1.5 = 0.866/1.5 = 0.577 → r = 35.3°. Refraction is governed by Snell's law, n₁sin i = n₂sin r. Light bends because its speed changes on entering the new medium. The deciding feature here is the refraction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140055: Change AC voltage is correct. Transformers work only with AC to change voltage. The deciding feature here is the electromagnetic induction relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140056: 5 m/s² is correct. a = F/m = 10/2 = 5 m/s². The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140057: Amplitude is correct. Loudness is determined by the amplitude of the sound wave. The deciding feature here is the characteristics of sound relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140058: Cross-sectional area is correct. R = ρL/A, so R ∝ 1/A. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140059: Towards the equilibrium position is correct. In SHM, acceleration is always directed towards the equilibrium position. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140060: 24 kg·m/s is correct. p = mv = 6×4 = 24 kg·m/s. Momentum is p = mv, and in an isolated system total momentum is conserved during a collision or interaction. The deciding feature here is the motion relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140061: 90° is correct. At the magnetic poles, the angle of dip is 90°. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140062: Potential energy is correct. A stretched spring stores elastic potential energy. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140063: 0.2 m is correct. f = 1/P = 1/5 = 0.2 m. Lens questions are governed by the lens formula 1/f = 1/u + 1/v together with the magnification relationship when image size is involved. The deciding feature here is the optical instruments relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140064: 20 Ω is correct. R = R₁ + R₂ = 12+8 = 20 Ω. In series, the same current passes through every resistor and the total resistance is the sum of the individual resistances. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140065: 160 J is correct. KE = ½mv² = 0.5×5×64 = 160 J. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140066: Volt is correct. Voltage is measured in volts (V). The deciding feature here is the electrostatics relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140067: Virtual and magnified is correct. Object between pole and focus (u < f) gives virtual, erect, magnified image. The deciding feature here is the reflection relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140068: 340 m/s is correct. The speed of sound in air at room temperature is about 340 m/s. The deciding feature here is the characteristics of sound relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140069: 100 J is correct. Work = mgh = 1×10×10 = 100 J. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140070: Cannot be created or destroyed is correct. Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed. The deciding feature here is the work, energy and power relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1140071: 350 m/s is correct. v = fλ = 500×0.7 = 350 m/s. The wave relationship v = fλ links speed, frequency and wavelength; use the quantities actually supplied by the question. The deciding feature here is the waves relationship described in the question.
